_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH ONLY - the Claude Code CLI does NOT read this file. A project-level .claude/hooks/hooks.json is a hook source for *plugins*, not for projects; the CLI reads project hooks from .claude/settings.json. This file is the annotated original. After editing it, merge its .hooks key into .claude/settings.json with SpecRoute's tools/sync-hooks-to-settings.sh.
_comment_paths: Commands resolve through ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.} so they fire regardless of the tool call's working directory.
_comment_events: SessionStart prints the project status banner. PreToolUse gates publish commands on the sanitization wordlist. PostToolUse warns (never blocks) on malformed agent / skill / command frontmatter.
